newsitem.title: USA: Tower to buy A.O. Smith auto unit.
newsitem.headline: Tower to buy A.O. Smith auto unit.

text.p: Tower Automotive Inc. said Monday it has a definitive agreement to acquire Automotive Products Co., another maker of vehicle components, from A.O. Smith Corp. for $625 million in cash.

Milwaukee-based Automotive Products makes structural parts, assemblies and systems for Ford Motor Co., Chrysler Corp., General Motors Co., Toyota, Nissan, Honda and Isuzu, as well as heavy truck manufacturers. It has 11 plants in North America and annual revenues of about $860 million.

"The acquisition of APC with its excellent people, products and plants is consistent with our strategy of increasing our module capabilities on a global basis," said Tower President and Chief Executive Dugald Campbell.
The deal is expected to close early in the second quarter, subject to regulatory approval.
Tower said it has obtained a commitment from Bank of America N.T. & S.A. to provide funding for the acquisition and ongoing operational requirements.

Tower makes engineered structural and chassis and suspension components and assemblies for North American car, mini-van and light truck manufacturers. It has operating headquarters in Grand Rapids, Mich. and a corporate office in Minneapolis.
Tower's stock jumped $3.50 to $37.50 on Nasdaq, while A.O. Smith gained $2 to $32 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
